svg.title: TabMLPDenoise architecture
svg.desc: Data-flow diagram of TabMLPDenoise. Main flow: per-column tokenization (teal=numerical periodic embed, purple=categorical embed+proj), cross-modal fusion (FiLM gate + cross-attention), column self-attention, mean pooling, label injection + proj_fuse, AdaLN-MLP residual blocks, split output heads. Conditioning branch (amber): time/label embeddings feed AdaLN scale-shift and label injection via dashed paths.

g.text: AdaLN: scale & shift from emb = t_emb + y_emb
